items.title: M1 brows float as dark planks
items.evidence: 1_beauty az000/hero and 2_closeups head: brow is a seated wedge on the disc top with no gap, tips inside head outline; techqa piece_brow sliver 0.

items.title: M2 two goggle rings instead of one facial disc
items.evidence: 1_beauty az000: one cream disc with the beak root between the eyes, dark rim on outer edge only, eye domes inside head outline; az090 dome not past brow line.

items.title: M3 feet are tan bricks
items.evidence: 1_beauty az000 feet: narrower, cream leg runs to ankle, talons at toe tips, but each foot is still one flat tan plate, not separate toes; 2_closeups hind limb shows a flat slab.

items.title: M4 tail is a lump, no fan
items.evidence: 1_beauty back34 and 5_reference top show a dark scalloped fan, but it is small against the reference fan and az090 shows it edge-on as a thin stick; 3_tech back34 shows a teal clip patch at the tail root.

items.title: M5 belly cream blob with saw border
items.evidence: 1_beauty az000: three bands (brown upper chest, mid-tan band, cream lower belly), cream no longer reaches the face, borders snapped to loops; edge is still faceted but straight.
